layout_sources: https://github.com/Eazhi/beancount-sog (2023 importer: reads latin-1, skips the first line and a blank second line when present, semicolon DictReader on "Date de l'opération", "Détail de l'écriture", "Montant de l'opération"; amounts parsed by swapping the comma for a point, so no thousands mark; label prefixes CARTE, PRELEVEMENT EUROPEEN, VIR RECU, VIR INST RE ...)

https://enodev.fr/posts/fin-du-qif-a-la-societe-generale.html (the CSV: first line is the account number written ="..." so Excel keeps the leading zeros, next the column names; ISO-8859 with CRLF; six months of history)
notes: Particuliers site "Télécharger" CSV: the account number on its own line as ="00012345678";, a blank line (the newer form that beancount-sog handles; older files put the header straight after), then "Date de l'opération;Libellé;Détail de l'écriture;Montant de l'opération;Devise". Semicolon, unquoted, dd/mm/yyyy, one signed amount with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, Devise EUR. Latin-1 (accents in the header), CRLF. Newest first assumed. No balance in the file. File name invented.
